summary: Executed frontend-only mobile-first Expo web preview testing for synthwave cyber-neon pixel redesign. Login and bottom-tab regression flows pass; redesigned Auth, Marketplace, Sell, Deal Room, and Profile screens render and remain interactive.

ui_bugs.component: Bottom navigation + segmented auth controls + filter chips
ui_bugs.issue: Several interactive elements still do not expose testID/data-testid (nav Pressables, auth mode switch, category/filter chips), reducing reliable React Native automation coverage.

issues: Interactive chips/segments use minHeight 34-42px (below recommended 44px touch target for mobile accessibility).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: deprecated textShadow* and shadow* props on web runtime; migrate to textShadow and boxShadow to avoid future regressions.

action_items: Add testID props to bottom nav buttons, auth mode toggle buttons, and marketplace category/filter chips.
Increase tappable target size for segment/filter chip controls to at least 44px.
Replace deprecated shadow/text shadow style props used by web runtime to remove warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: API base URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend; project standard states EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Align to one canonical env key to avoid configuration drift.
Main screen file (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx) is very large (~1500+ lines); split by screen/tab components for maintainability and safer regression testing.
seed_data_creation: No dedicated seed script created. One test listing was submitted via Sell form during UI validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials verified from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used successfully: seller4@maskmarket.io. Core login and tab navigation regression passed on public preview URL.
rca_of_issue: Repro for missing testability: open app and inspect nav/filter/auth toggle controls; they are Pressables without testID, forcing fragile text-based selectors. Repro for mobile touch target concern: inspect styles segmentBtn(minHeight:42) and filterChip(minHeight:34), below 44px accessibility guideline.
